spans.s: + अग्र मण्डल- + अग्र, m. a sword.
+ उत्तम मण्डल- + उत्तम, n. a principal kingdom,
Rājat. 5, 262
+ उदक मण्ड- + उदक, n. 1. variegated colour. 2. painting figures.
+ कानन मणि- + कानन, n. 1. a wood abounding in jewels. 2. the throat.
+ प्रवेक मणि- + प्रवेक, most excellent jewels,
+ बन्ध मणि- + बन्ध, m. the wrist.
+ बन्धन मणि- + बन्धन, n. the wrist, Śāk. d. 61.
+ भद्र मणि- + भद्र, m. a name of Kuvera,

मण्, i. 1, Par. To sound, to murmur.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मणित,
Nalod. 2, 60
. n. A murmuring sound.

मणि, m. and f., and मणी मणी, f.
 1. A precious stone, a jewel, Vikr. d. 40.
 2. A pearl, Vikr. d. 51.
 3. Fleshy processes hanging from the neck of a goat.
 4. A waterpot.
 --Comp.

मणि + क,
 I. m. A precious stone, a jewel.
 II. n. A small waterpot, Pārask. in Journ. of the German Oriental Society, ix. xxi. n. 4.
माणिका (akin to मणि), f. A weight of eight Palas.
मणि-कार, m. A jeweller.
मणि-मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of jewels,
Megh. 65

.
 --Comp.

मणीचक, m.
 1. The kingfisher.
 2. The moon-stone, a fabulous stone.
मणीवक, n. A flower.
† मण्ठ् मण्ठ्, i. 1, Ātm. To remember with regret.

मण्ड् (akin to मद्, मन्द्, probably a denomin. based on a lost signification of मन्द्र), † i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To dress.
 2. To divide.
 --† i. 1, Par. To adorn one's self.
 --i. 10, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm.,

),
 1. To adorn, Pañc. 255, 16.
 2. † To exhilarate.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मण्डित, Adorned,

; Pañc. 51, 15.
 --Comp.

मण्ड् + अ,
 I. m.
 1.

Ornament.
 2

. The castor-oil tree, Palma christi.
 II. m. (and n.).
 1. Scum, Utt.

Rāmac. 90, 7.
 2

Pith.
 3
. The head,
Lass. 4, 18

.
 III. f. डा.
 1. Spirituous liquor.
 2. Emblic myrobalan.
 --Comp.
मण्ड + क, m. A kind of pastry, Pañc. 245, 24 (see my translation, n. 1387).

मण्ड् + अन, n.
 1. Dressing, Pañc. 116, 21 (of the idols).
 2. Ornament, Vikr. d. 157.

मण्ड-प (vb. पा), m. (and n.).
 1. A shed or hall erected on festival occasions, as marriages, and adorned with flowers, Pañc. 129, 17.
 2. An open temple.
 3. A bower,
Megh. 76

.
 --Comp.
मण्डपिका, i. e. मण्डप + क, f. A small shop,
मण्डयन्त् + अ (vb. मण्ड्), m. An ornament.

मण्डल,
 I. m.
 1. A sort of sacrifice.
 2. A kind of snake.
 3. A dog.
 II. f. ली.
 1. A circle, Utt.

Rāmac. 66, 4.
 2
. Walking round,
Sund. 3, 22

; 24.
 3. Bent grass.
 4. A nest,
Daśak. 151, 6

.
 III. n. (and m.).
 1. A circle, Vikr. d. 140; Pañc. 230, 18; a globe, a ball, Pañc. 157, 25.
 2. The disk of the sun or moon, Pañc. 160, 23.
 3. The halo round the sun.
 4. A wheel, Utt.
. A heap, a multitude, Pañc. iii. d. 224; Ṛt. 1, 10 (at the end of a comp. adj.); a troop,
. A district, a province,
Rājat. 5, 146

; an empire, ib. 155, 262.
 7. Surrounding countries,

. A form of array, an army drawn up in a circle, Pañc. 9, 14.
 9. Twelve great empires, into which the whole of India is said to have been divided in old times.
 10. A sort of leprosy with circular spots.
 11. A sort of mystical, diagram,
Lass. 13, 18

(?).
 12. A sort of perfume,
Lass. 20, 20

(? corr. perhaps मण्डन, cf. मण्डन and गज-मण्डन, s. v. भूति).
 --Comp.
मण्डलय, a denomin. derived from the preceeding; with परि परि, in the ptcple. pf. pass. [] परिमण्डलित, Turned round,

मण्डलिन्, i. e. मण्डल + इन्, m.
 1. A snake.
 2. A cat.

मण्डूक,
 I. m.
 1. A frog, Pañc. 197, 21.
 2. A flower, Bignonia indica.
 II. f. की, A female frog.
 --Comp.
मण्डूर, m. and n. Rust of iron.
+ मन्थ मणि- + मन्थ, n. rock-salt.
माणिमन्थ, i. e. मणि-मन्थ + अ, n. Sea-salt.

माणव (= मानव. q. cf.), m.
 1. A child.
 2. A man, in a contemptuous sense.
 3. A necklace of sixteen strings.
माणव + क, m. A proper name,
Vikr. 44, 12

माणिक्य, i. e. मणि + क + य,
 I. n. A ruby, Pañc. 207, 23.
 II. f. या, A house-lizard.
माण्डलिक, i. e. मण्डल + इक, [] m. The superintendent of a district or province.
माण्डव्य, i. e. मण्डु, A proper name, + य, patronym., m. A proper name,
मणि-मेखल, adj. surrounded by jewels. Ṛt. 6, 3.
+ वीज मणि- + वीज, m. the pomegranate.
+ व्यूह मण्डल- + व्यूह, m. the array in a circle, cf. Pañc. 9, 14.
मणि-शङ्ख-शर्कर, adj. having shells and gravel consisting of jewels,
, ed. Seramp.
+ सर मणि- + सर, m. a necklace, Utt.
Rāmac. 18, 6
+ हर्म्य मणि- + हर्म्य, n. a pavilion of gems,
Vikr. 38, 11
+ हारक मण्ड- + हारक, m. a distiller.
